title: STI Testing
summary: STI testing uses urine samples, swabs or blood tests. Regular testing — and before a new partner — is the only reliable way to know your status, since many STIs have no symptoms.
key_points: Some infections need time after exposure to show up on tests (window period).
Partners sharing results is a healthy, normal practice.
answer_guidance: Explain factually and non-graphically in the user's language (English, Banglish or Bengali). Start with a simple definition and add detail only if asked. Be non-judgemental; mention consent, safety or seeing a doctor only where genuinely relevant.
